t: Visitors tracks who is coming to the office, who is in the building, and tells their host.
In this video, you will learn how to expect a visitor, check people in and out, and use the reception tablet.
Click Work in the left menu, then Visitors.
The numbers show visitors expected, in the building, left, and today's total.
The list shows each visitor, their host, and whether they are expected, in the building, or have left.
Press Expect a visitor. Type their name, phone, company, why they are coming, who they are meeting, and when.
When they arrive, press Checked in, and Left when they go. Walk-in adds someone who just turned up.
Their host gets a card in chat: I'm coming, or Ask them to wait.
Open the reception tablet link on a tablet at your front desk. Visitors sign themselves in, and their host is told.
Next in the Alerts & settings menu: Shankh alerts.
